name: Hautes-Côtes de Nuits

known.via: English Wikipedia "Hautes-Côtes de Nuits" (a wine place on Wikidata)

terms: France's protected place names. A wine sold under one must follow that appellation's rules. The EU's term for the same tier is PDO, or AOP in French.
Bourgogne, village, Premier Cru, Grand Cru
Burgundy's four levels, from regional Bourgogne up through village wines to Premier Cru and Grand Cru vineyards.

blurb.text: A Burgundy sub-region on top of and behind the Côte de Nuits escarpment, in valleys and slopes. Its wines are labeled Bourgogne Hautes Côtes de Nuits, a named area within the Bourgogne AOC, for red wine based on Pinot Noir, white from Chardonnay and Pinot Blanc, and some rosé. It has no Premier Cru vineyards.
